x: There have been medals in the Kent county championships - Nigel Whorlow, 3000m walk (gold), Wesley Swaffer, 2000m steeplechase (bronze), Amy Butler, 2500m walk (bronze), Jason Stevens, 600m (bronze) as well as two finalists, Paul Hills (100m and 200m - 4th in both) and Bobby Peacock (400m - 5th).
The 1994 individual best times were: U17 Bobby Peacock, 2:48 (12th lap), U15 Nigel Whorlow, 3:26 (10th lap), U13 Jason Stevens, 3:26 (9th lap).
